device_type.description: A device type (type_id of a device descriptor)

i2c_address.description: A 7-bit address on an I2C bus

vm_object.description: A VM object by its id: a variable of the program or one of its elements

vm_accessor.description: A VM accessor by its id: the path a block reads or writes through

vm_block.description: A VM block by its place in the execution order

vm_block_input.description: An input pin of a VM block, from 0

vm_block_output.description: An output pin of a VM block, from 0

vm_block_enable.description: An enable source of a VM block, from 0

vm_block_type.description: A VM block type (wire_id of a block descriptor)

vm_op.description: A command of the VM router

action.description: A stored action by its ID

project_section.description: A section of the stored project by its ID

stream.description: A data stream by its id (the first byte of its frames)

contract.description: A device contract by its ID

tags.name: ERR_POOL_EMPTY
tags.description: no block for a new error
tags.message: The board ran out of room to record error details

tags.name: ERR_ESP_ERR
tags.description: ESP-IDF call failed
tags.message: A system call failed ({code})

tags.name: ERR_RECORD_CUT
tags.description: err_record_parse: cut short
tags.message: An error report of {len} bytes from another board was cut short

tags.name: ERR_NULL_PTR
tags.description: a C function got a NULL pointer: its caller's bug
tags.message: A function was called with a NULL pointer

tags.name: ERR_RANGE
tags.description: ERR_CHECK_RANGE
tags.message: The value {value} is outside {min}..{max}

tags.name: ERR_RANGE_F
tags.description: ERR_CHECK_RANGE, float v
tags.message: The value {value} is outside {min}..{max}

tags.name: ERR_BAD_ARG
tags.description: invalid argument or request value
tags.message: An argument or request value is not valid

tags.name: ERR_NO_MEM
tags.description: out of memory (bytes requested)
tags.message: Out of memory ({size} bytes needed)
tags.hint: Free memory by removing unused devices, providers, or buffers.

tags.name: ERR_FULL
tags.description: fixed table or slot pool reached its limit
tags.message: No free slot left (limit {max})
tags.hint: Remove an unused entry first or raise the configured limit.

tags.name: ERR_BUSY
tags.description: another operation is already in progress
tags.message: Another operation is already in progress
tags.hint: Wait for the current operation to finish and try again.

tags.name: ERR_BAD_OFFSET
tags.description: chunked transfer offset mismatch
tags.message: Wrong offset {got} (expected {want})
tags.hint: Restart the transfer from offset 0.

tags.name: ERR_IO_PIN_IN_USE
tags.description: SET_MODE of a configured pin; mode = the current one
tags.message: {pin} of {id} is already set up as {mode}
tags.hint: Reset the pin first, or keep its mode: a pin is set up once.

tags.name: ERR_IO_PIN_UNCONFIGURED
tags.description: the op needs SET_MODE first
tags.message: {pin} of {id} is not set up yet
tags.hint: Set the pin's mode first (Devices: the pin's Mode, or Set mode), then use it.

tags.name: ERR_IO_WRONG_MODE
tags.description: the op doesn't fit the pin's current mode
tags.message: {pin} of {id} is {mode}: it cannot do that
tags.hint: Use a command that fits the pin's mode, or reset the pin and set another mode.

tags.name: ERR_IO_MODE_UNSUPPORTED
tags.description: this pin / device can't do the mode
tags.message: {pin} of {id} cannot be {mode}
tags.hint: Choose a mode this pin offers, or another pin.

tags.name: ERR_IO_FEATURE_UNSUPPORTED
tags.description: e.g. ADC on a pin without ADC
tags.message: {pin} of {id} does not support that
tags.hint: Use a pin that has it (the device page lists what each pin can do).

tags.name: ERR_IO_PWM_CHANNELS_EXHAUSTED
tags.message: {pin} of {id}: all {channels} PWM channels are in use
tags.hint: Reset a PWM pin you no longer need, or use a PWM expander.

tags.name: ERR_IO_PWM_TIMERS_EXHAUSTED
tags.description: a new frequency needs a timer and none is free
tags.message: {pin} of {id}: no PWM timer is free for {frequency_Hz} (all {timers} in use)
tags.hint: Use a frequency another PWM pin already runs at, or reset a PWM pin you no longer need.

tags.name: ERR_IO_BAD_READING
tags.description: an ADC didn't return the channel asked for
tags.message: {pin} of {id} returned a wrong reading
tags.hint: Read it again; if it keeps failing, restart the board.

tags.name: ERR_I2C_BAD_DEV_CFG
tags.description: not a 7-bit address, or speed 0
tags.message: {addr} on {bus} is not a valid device setting

tags.name: ERR_I2C_BUS_INIT
tags.description: over its cause
tags.message: {bus} could not start on pins {sda} (SDA) and {scl} (SCL)

tags.name: ERR_I2C_BUS_STUCK
tags.description: probe timed out: bus busy, SCL held low or no pull-ups
tags.message: {bus} is stuck while reaching {addr}: check the wiring and pull-ups
tags.hint: Check the wiring and the pull-up resistors, then restart the board.

tags.name: ERR_I2C_BUS_RESET
tags.description: over its cause
tags.message: {bus} could not be reset

tags.name: ERR_I2C_DEV_NOT_FOUND
tags.description: nothing acked the address
tags.message: Nothing answers at {addr} on {bus}
tags.hint: Check that the module is connected and powered, and that its address is right.

tags.name: ERR_I2C_DEV_ADD
tags.description: over its cause
tags.message: {addr} on {bus} could not be added

tags.name: ERR_I2C_DEV_REMOVE
tags.description: over its cause
tags.message: {addr} on {bus} could not be removed

tags.name: ERR_I2C_DEV_NOT_ADDED
tags.description: transfer to an address not attached
tags.message: {addr} on {bus} is not attached

tags.name: ERR_I2C_NO_ACK
tags.description: NACK / aborted transfer
tags.message: {addr} on {bus} did not answer
tags.hint: Check the wiring and the power of the module.

tags.name: ERR_I2C_BUS_BUSY
tags.description: bus lock timed out
tags.message: {bus} stayed busy while reaching {addr}
tags.hint: Try again; if it repeats, check the wiring of the bus.

tags.name: ERR_I2C_XFER
tags.description: other failure, over its cause
tags.message: A transfer with {addr} on {bus} failed
tags.hint: Check the wiring and the power of the module.

tags.name: ERR_I2C_REG
tags.description: context only: register access
tags.message: At register {reg}

tags.name: ERR_I2C_ADDR_TAKEN
tags.description: another chip is attached at this address: `owner` is its device (SYS_DEVICE_ID_NONE: no device)
tags.message: {addr} on {bus} is already used by {owner}
tags.hint: Two devices cannot share an address: change one of them (its address pins or setting).

tags.name: ERR_I2C_NOT_OWNER
tags.description: DETACH or XFER by a caller that did not attach the address: `owner` did
tags.message: {addr} on {bus} belongs to {owner}: only that device can use or free it

tags.name: ERR_UART_BUSY
tags.description: TX queue full (or SPARE past half) in wait_ms
tags.message: UART port {port} TX queue is full

tags.name: ERR_UART_BAD_BAUD
tags.description: outside SYS_UART_BAUD_MIN..MAX
tags.message: {baud} is not a baud rate this UART takes
tags.hint: Choose a rate from 1200 to 5000000.

tags.name: ERR_UART_INIT
tags.description: the driver refused the port's UART
tags.message: UART {port} could not start

tags.name: ERR_UART_IN_USE
tags.description: the port is held by a reader or a send that would break its frames: `owner` the subscriber (SYS_DEVICE_ID_NONE: a hook or a read)
tags.message: UART port {port} is in use by device {owner}
tags.hint: A subscriber, a session or a stream is using this port.

tags.name: ERR_CMD_BAD_LEN
tags.description: payload size
tags.message: The command carries {got} bytes; it needs {need}

tags.name: ERR_CMD_OUT_FULL
tags.description: answer does not fit the link
tags.message: The answer needs {need} bytes; the link takes {cap}

tags.name: ERR_CMD_DIRECTION
tags.description: the command has no such side, or dir is neither read nor write
tags.message: The command has no {dir} side
tags.hint: Read a command that can be read, write one that can be written.

tags.name: ERR_ROUTER_KEY
tags.description: context only: route step at the root
tags.message: In {key}

tags.name: ERR_ROUTER_OP
tags.description: context only: route step in a module
tags.message: In command {code}

tags.name: ERR_ROUTER_NO_KEY
tags.description: the command ended where its key or its op code was expected
tags.message: The command ends before it says what it is for

tags.name: ERR_ROUTER_UNKNOWN_KEY
tags.description: no module under the root key
tags.message: The board has nothing that answers {key}

tags.name: ERR_ROUTER_UNKNOWN_OP
tags.description: no command of the module has the code
tags.message: There is no command {code} here

tags.name: ERR_ROUTER_KEY_TAKEN
tags.message: {key} is registered twice

tags.name: ERR_ROUTER_TABLE_FULL
tags.message: No room to register {key}

tags.name: ERR_ROUTER_QUEUE_FULL
tags.description: command not queued
tags.message: The board is busy: a command from {src} was dropped
tags.hint: Send commands less often.

tags.name: ERR_ROUTER_FRAME_LEN
tags.description: request too short or too long
tags.message: A command of {len} bytes from {src} was refused (at most {max})

tags.name: ERR_ROUTER_NO_PORT
tags.description: a call to a port that is not registered
tags.message: Connection {port} cannot be reached from here
tags.hint: Attach its session first.

tags.name: ERR_ROUTER_CALL_TIMEOUT
tags.description: a call without an answer
tags.message: Connection {port} did not answer
tags.hint: A write may still have run: read the value back.

tags.name: ERR_ROUTER_CALL_DOWN
tags.description: the link the call went out on ended
tags.message: Connection {port} was lost before its answer came

tags.name: ERR_REMOTE
tags.description: context: the chain below is that board's
tags.message: On board {board}

tags.name: ERR_NVS_NO_CHUNK
tags.message: The file has no chunk {chunk}

tags.name: ERR_NVS_NOT_FOUND
tags.description: get, erase: no such key
tags.message: No such value is stored

tags.name: ERR_ACTION_NOT_FOUND
tags.message: {id} does not exist
tags.hint: Write the project to the board (toolbar), or check which action is called.

tags.name: ERR_ACTION_NO_DRAFT
tags.description: no record is being written
tags.message: No record is being written

tags.name: ERR_ACTION_TOO_BIG
tags.message: The action is {len} bytes; at most {max} fit
tags.hint: Split the action into smaller ones.

tags.name: ERR_ACTION_INCOMPLETE
tags.description: commit before every byte came
tags.message: The record is incomplete ({got} of {want} bytes)
tags.hint: Write it again.

tags.name: ERR_ACTION_CRC
tags.message: The record is damaged (checksum {got}, expected {want})
tags.hint: Write it again.

tags.name: ERR_ACTION_BAD_FRAME
tags.description: image framing broken there
tags.message: The action is broken at byte {offset}

tags.name: ERR_ACTION_EMPTY
tags.description: a record with no frame
tags.message: The record has no command
tags.hint: Add a command to the action.

tags.name: ERR_ACTION_DEPTH
tags.description: RUN nested deeper than CONFIG_SYS_ACTIONS_MAX_DEPTH
tags.message: Actions run each other {depth} levels deep: too deep
tags.hint: Make the actions call each other less deep.

tags.name: ERR_ACTION_WRONG_TASK
tags.description: sys_actions_run outside a router task
tags.message: An action was started from the wrong place

tags.name: ERR_ACTION_STEP
tags.description: context: frame `step` (from 0) failed
tags.message: In step {step} of {id}

tags.name: ERR_ACTION_BAD_ID
tags.description: ID 0 (SYS_ACTIONS_ID_NONE)
tags.message: Action ID 0 is not valid

tags.name: ERR_WATCH_NOT_FOUND
tags.message: Watch {id} not found
tags.hint: Check WATCH LIST.

tags.name: ERR_WATCH_NOT_READ
tags.description: ADD/read: request is no read
tags.message: Watch {id} request is not a read
tags.hint: Only commands with dir CMD_DIR_READ (0) can be watched.

tags.name: ERR_WATCH_NO_VALUE
tags.description: cached read: no valid copy yet
tags.message: No cached watch value from board {board} yet

tags.name: ERR_WATCH_STALE
tags.description: cached read: copy too old
tags.message: Cached watch value from board {board} is stale ({age_ms} ms old)

tags.name: ERR_PROV_NOT_FOUND
tags.message: Data provider {provider} was not found
tags.hint: Check the provider ID or create the provider first.

tags.name: ERR_PROV_ID_TAKEN
tags.description: create: id taken
tags.message: Data provider {provider} already exists
tags.hint: Choose another provider ID or remove the existing one first.

tags.name: ERR_PROV_IN_USE
tags.description: create: a provider only one of may exist
tags.message: Data provider {provider} cannot be made twice
tags.hint: Remove the one that exists first.

tags.name: ERR_PROV_SYSTEM
tags.description: remove: the board's own
tags.message: Cannot remove system data provider {provider}
tags.hint: Built-in board providers cannot be removed.

tags.name: ERR_PROV_TYPE_UNKNOWN
tags.description: CREATE with unknown type
tags.message: Unknown data provider type ({type})

tags.name: ERR_PROV_UNKNOWN_OP
tags.description: op not in contract / type table, or missing side
tags.message: Provider does not support operation {op}

tags.name: ERR_PROV_ID
tags.description: context: the provider of a call or create
tags.message: In data provider {provider}

tags.name: ERR_SESSION_ID_TAKEN
tags.description: hello: two peers with one id, or an id of the wrong kind
tags.message: Two boards have the id {board}
tags.hint: Give one of them another id.

tags.name: ERR_SESSION_NO_ROUTE
tags.description: no session leads to dst
tags.message: Board {dst} cannot be reached from here

tags.name: ERR_SESSION_NOT_FRAMED
tags.description: attach: no provider, or a raw one: no whole frame
tags.message: A session needs a link that carries a whole frame; this one is raw, or there is none
tags.hint: Attach a session to a framed provider.

tags.name: ERR_BLE_STACK
tags.message: Bluetooth failed (code {rc})

tags.name: ERR_BLE_ADV
tags.message: The board could not start advertising (code {rc})

tags.name: ERR_BLE_GATT
tags.message: Bluetooth service {uuid} could not be changed (code {rc})

tags.name: ERR_BLE_SVC_LOCKED
tags.message: Bluetooth service {uuid} cannot be changed
tags.hint: This service belongs to the board: add a service of your own instead.

tags.name: ERR_BLE_UUID_TAKEN
tags.message: Bluetooth {uuid} is already in use
tags.hint: Choose another UUID.

tags.name: ERR_BLE_NOT_FOUND
tags.message: Bluetooth {uuid} does not exist
tags.hint: Check the UUID, or apply the Bluetooth settings first.

tags.name: ERR_BLE_UUID
tags.description: context: BLE service or characteristic
tags.message: In Bluetooth {uuid}

tags.name: ERR_BLE_NO_TX
tags.message: Bluetooth {uuid} cannot send
tags.hint: Give the characteristic a send buffer with notify or indicate.

tags.name: ERR_BLE_TX_FULL
tags.message: Bluetooth {uuid} is full: {len} bytes were not sent
tags.hint: Send less often, or make the send buffer larger.

tags.name: ERR_BLE_TOO_LONG
tags.message: {len} bytes are too long for Bluetooth {uuid} (at most {max})
tags.hint: Send less at once, or make the buffer larger.

tags.name: ERR_BLE_FRAG
tags.message: Bluetooth {uuid}: a packet came out of order and its frame was dropped

tags.name: ERR_BLE_HOOK
tags.message: Bluetooth {uuid} already has a receiver

tags.name: ERR_EVENT_QUEUE_FULL
tags.message: Too many events: {dropped} from {source} were dropped
tags.hint: The source sends events faster than they are taken: slow it down.

tags.name: ERR_EVENT_NOT_FOUND
tags.description: subscription handle
tags.message: Event subscription {id} does not exist

tags.name: ERR_EVENT_DELIVERY
tags.description: context: a listener failed
tags.message: While a listener handled event {event} of {source} ({channel})

tags.name: ERR_DEV_BAD_ID
tags.description: SYS_DEVICE_ID_NONE
tags.message: {id} is not a valid device ID

tags.name: ERR_DEV_NOT_FOUND
tags.message: {id} does not exist
tags.hint: Write the project to the board (toolbar), or check the device ID.

tags.name: ERR_DEV_ID_TAKEN
tags.message: The ID of {id} is already taken
tags.hint: Give the device another ID.

tags.name: ERR_DEV_TYPE_UNKNOWN
tags.message: The board does not know {type}
tags.hint: Update the board's firmware, or remove the device: this firmware has no driver for it.

tags.name: ERR_DEV_SUSPENDED
tags.message: {id} is suspended
tags.hint: Resume it (Devices: the device, Resume) once the cause is fixed.

tags.name: ERR_DEV_INSTALL
tags.description: context: create failed
tags.message: While creating {id} ({type})

tags.name: ERR_DEV_ID
tags.description: context: the device of a call
tags.message: In {id}

tags.name: ERR_DEV_BAD_PIN
tags.message: {id} has no {pin}
tags.hint: Choose a pin the device has.

tags.name: ERR_DEV_OP
tags.description: context: route step
tags.message: In {op}

tags.name: ERR_DEV_UNKNOWN_OP
tags.description: an op (contract) the device doesn't have
tags.message: The device cannot do {op}
tags.hint: This device does not have that command: use one from its list.

tags.name: ERR_DEV_PIN_LOCKED
tags.description: a write of a pin another device locked: only its owner writes it; `owner` is the device that locked it (SYS_DEVICE_ID_NONE: no device)
tags.message: {pin} of {id} is held by {owner}
tags.hint: Change the pin through the device that holds it, or choose a free pin.

tags.name: ERR_DEV_IN_USE
tags.description: REMOVE of a device others use: bit i = device i
tags.message: {id} cannot be removed: other devices use it ({users})
tags.hint: Remove or change the devices that use it first.

tags.name: ERR_DEV_FAULT_RESPONSE
tags.description: the policy's response to an error of device `id` failed (stage: sys_device_fault_stage_e); diagnostics only
tags.message: The response to an error of {id} failed (step {stage}, {action})
tags.hint: Check the device's error policy and the action it runs. At the step Queue the board had too many errors at once to respond to this one.

tags.name: ERR_DEV_SYSTEM
tags.description: REMOVE of a board device (SYS_DEVICE_CREATE_SYSTEM)
tags.message: {id} is part of the board and cannot be removed

tags.name: ERR_DEV_REMOTE_DOWN
tags.description: a remote device whose board is gone, or no sys_device_remote on this board
tags.message: Device {id} is on board {board}, which cannot be reached
tags.hint: Check the cable or the link to that board.

tags.name: ERR_DEV_LOCAL_OP
tags.description: an op the firmware calls only in C (SYS_DEVICE_OP_LOCAL), sent as a command or to a remote device
tags.message: {op} runs only inside the board, not as a command
tags.hint: The board's own modules use it (a display's FLUSH is sent by the screen adapter).

tags.name: ERR_DEV_REENTRY
tags.description: a task took the lock of a device it holds already (the lock is not recursive)
tags.message: {id} was called from inside its own call
tags.hint: A device operation must not call its own device.

tags.name: ERR_DEV_NOT_LOCKED
tags.description: a slot was changed without its lock
tags.message: {id} was changed without its lock
tags.hint: Take the lock of the device first (sys_device_slot_lock).

tags.name: ERR_DEV_BUSY
tags.description: the lock of a device was not free in time: `op` is the op that holds it
tags.message: {id} is busy with {op} and did not answer in time
tags.hint: Try again; if it stays busy, the device or the bus it is on does not answer.

tags.name: ERR_DEV_CYCLE
tags.description: device `id` would use `dep`, which uses `id` already (itself or through others)
tags.message: {id} cannot use {dep}: {dep} already uses {id}
tags.hint: Two devices cannot use each other: change one of them.

tags.name: ERR_DEV_PIN_NOT_OWNED
tags.description: UNLOCK by a caller that did not lock the pin: `owner` did (SYS_DEVICE_ID_NONE: no device)
tags.message: {pin} of {id} belongs to {owner}: only that device can free it

tags.name: ERR_DEV_REMOTE_DEP
tags.description: device `id` uses a remote device `dep`: allowed, its calls go over the way (latency, a WIRED wait under the lock of `id`)
tags.message: {id} uses {dep}, a device of another board: its calls go over the connection
tags.hint: Slower, and a wired call waits under the lock of {id}. Use a device of this board where timing matters.

tags.name: ERR_REMOTE_NOT_WIRED
tags.description: a wired remote device's board is reached by a way that is not wired: its calls do not wait (once until wired again)
tags.message: Board {board} is not reached by a cable now: its wired devices do not wait for their answers
tags.hint: The program's timing has changed. Check the cable to that board.

tags.name: ERR_REMOTE_SUBS_FULL
tags.description: SUBSCRIBE with every CONFIG_SYS_DEVICE_REMOTE_SUBSCRIPTIONS slot taken
tags.message: Device {id} cannot be followed: {max} subscriptions to this board's devices already
tags.hint: Remove a remote device of this board on another board, or allow more subscriptions.

tags.name: ERR_POWER_BAD_CHANNEL
tags.description: the device has no such channel
tags.message: {id} has no {channel}
tags.hint: Choose a channel the device has.

tags.name: ERR_POWER_ALERT_UNSUPPORTED
tags.description: this channel / device can't do the alert (sys_power_alert_e)
tags.message: {channel} of {id} cannot raise the {alert} alert
tags.hint: Choose an alert this channel offers.

tags.name: ERR_POWER_EXT_FEEDBACK
tags.description: the regulator uses an external divider: its output can't be set in mV
tags.message: {id} uses an external divider: its output cannot be set in mV
tags.hint: Set it in its own terms (the device page says how), not in mV.

tags.name: ERR_POWER_NO_PROFILE
tags.description: the source offers no profile at or below the voltage (lowest_mV: the lowest fixed offer, 5 V when it offers none)
tags.message: {id}: the source offers nothing at or below {voltage_mV} (lowest {lowest_mV})
tags.hint: Use a charger that offers this voltage, or ask for a higher one.

tags.name: ERR_PWRM_NOT_READY
tags.description: before sys_power_manager_init
tags.message: The power manager is not ready

tags.name: ERR_PWRM_BUDGET_EXCEEDED
tags.description: a rail change that doesn't fit
tags.message: {id} needs {requested_mW}; only {available_mW} is available
tags.hint: Lower the load, switch off another rail, or use a stronger supply.

tags.name: ERR_PWRM_BELOW_ALLOCATION
tags.description: the budget shrank under what's committed
tags.message: The power budget fell to {limit_mW}, below the {allocated_mW} the outputs use
tags.hint: The supply gives less than before: lower the load or use a stronger supply.

tags.name: ERR_PWRM_FAULT
tags.description: a hardware fault and the response taken
tags.message: {kind} on {channel} of {source} ({value}): {response}
tags.hint: Check what is connected to that output (a short, too much load); the board reacted as its power settings say.

tags.name: ERR_PWRM_RAIL_TAKEN
tags.description: rail already registered
tags.message: {id} is already registered as a power rail
tags.hint: Remove the existing rail before adding it again.

tags.name: ERR_PWRM_NOT_RAIL
tags.description: a matrix row whose target is neither the board nor a rail of it
tags.message: {id} is not a power rail of the board
tags.hint: Choose the board or one of its power rails.

tags.name: ERR_VM_ALLOC_EXHAUSTED
tags.message: The program needs {requested} more bytes; {remaining} are left
tags.hint: Make the program smaller: fewer or shorter variables.

tags.name: ERR_VM_ACCESSOR_DEPTH_EXCEEDED

tags.name: ERR_VM_ACCESSOR_INDEX_FAILED
tags.message: {id}: the position at step {chain_pos} could not be read

tags.name: ERR_VM_ACCESSOR_NAME_NOT_FOUND

tags.name: ERR_VM_ACCESSOR_NOT_MUTABLE
tags.message: {id}: {obj_id} cannot be written (step {chain_pos})

tags.message: {pin_id} of {block_idx} is missing

tags.name: ERR_VM_BLOCK_PIN_UNLINKED
tags.message: {pin_id} of {block_idx} is not connected
tags.hint: Connect the pin.

tags.name: ERR_VM_BLOCK_FAILED
tags.message: {block_idx} ({block_type}) failed

tags.name: ERR_VM_OBJ_COPY_MISMATCH
tags.message: A {src_type} of {src_size} bytes cannot be copied into a {dst_type} of {dst_size} bytes

tags.name: ERR_VM_OBJ_COPY_SHAPE
tags.message: The values do not have the same shape (element {index}, level {depth})

tags.name: ERR_VM_OBJ_NOT_MUTABLE
tags.message: {obj_id} cannot be written

tags.name: ERR_VM_OBJ_OOB
tags.message: Position {index} is outside {obj_id}

tags.name: ERR_VM_OBJ_NOT_PTR
tags.message: {obj_id} is {actual}, not a folder

tags.name: ERR_VM_OBJ_BAD_TYPE
tags.message: {type} is not a type the board knows

tags.name: ERR_VM_OBJ_EMPTY
tags.message: A {type} with no elements

tags.name: ERR_VM_OBJ_BAD_SIZE
tags.message: A {type} of {payload_size} bytes does not split into elements of {width}

tags.name: ERR_VM_OBJ_NAME_TOO_LONG
tags.message: A name of {len} bytes is too long

tags.name: ERR_VM_OBJ_RETENTIVE_PTR
tags.message: A {type} cannot be kept across restarts

tags.name: ERR_VM_LOAD_BAD_STATE
tags.message: The program upload is {state}; {expected} was expected

tags.name: ERR_VM_LOAD_TOO_BIG
tags.message: The program needs {requested} bytes; the board has {available}
tags.hint: Make the program smaller.

tags.name: ERR_VM_LOAD_DATA_RANGE
tags.message: {id}: {len} values from {start_idx} do not fit its {items} elements

tags.name: ERR_VM_LOAD_SHORT_RECORD
tags.message: {packet} is cut short ({got} of {need} bytes)

tags.name: ERR_VM_ACC_INDEX_OOB
tags.message: {acc_id}: step {pos} is outside its {count} steps

tags.name: ERR_VM_ACC_BAD_KIND
tags.message: {acc_id}: step {pos} is {kind}, which is not allowed there

tags.name: ERR_VM_REG_OOB
tags.message: {id} is outside the {count} {kind} of the program

tags.name: ERR_VM_REG_DUP
tags.message: {id} is loaded twice

tags.name: ERR_VM_BLK_BAD_SHAPE
tags.message: {blk_id} has {in_cnt} inputs and {q_cnt} outputs: not what its type takes

tags.name: ERR_VM_BLK_BAD_REF
tags.message: {slot} of {blk_id} refers to {ref_id}, which does not exist

tags.name: ERR_VM_DYN_FULL
tags.message: No room for more dynamic values (at most {limit})

tags.name: ERR_VM_BLK_UNKNOWN_TYPE
tags.message: {blk_id}: the board has no {block_type}

tags.name: ERR_VM_EXEC_BLOCK_HUNG
tags.message: {block_idx} has run for {ms} ms without finishing
tags.hint: Check the block: a loop that never ends, or a device that does not answer.

tags.name: ERR_VM_EXEC_SPAN_DEPTH
tags.message: {block_idx}: loops are nested {depth} deep, too deep

tags.name: ERR_VM_EXEC_BAD_SPAN
tags.message: {block_idx}: its loop covers blocks {start} to {end}, which is not valid

tags.name: ERR_VM_EVENT_OVERFLOW
tags.message: Too many events from {source}: {dropped} dropped (queue of {depth})
tags.hint: The source sends events faster than the program takes them: slow it down.

tags.name: ERR_VM_EXPR_BAD_CODE
tags.message: {block_idx}: the formula is broken at {pc} ({opcode})

tags.name: ERR_VM_EXPR_MATH
tags.message: {block_idx}: the formula cannot compute {opcode} at {pc}
tags.hint: Check the formula: a division by zero, or a value out of range.

tags.name: ERR_VM_FOR_BAD_LOOP
tags.message: {block_idx}: the loop would run {turns} times (at most {cap})
tags.hint: Check the loop limits.

tags.name: ERR_VM_OBJ_OWNERSHIP
tags.message: A value is already placed elsewhere, would contain itself, or is nested too deep (at most {limit})

tags.name: ERR_VM_OBJ_USR_PROTECTED
tags.message: {obj_id} cannot be changed from the app
tags.hint: Change it in the program, not from the app.

tags.name: ERR_VM_LOAD_RUNNING
tags.message: The program cannot be changed while it runs ({mode})
tags.hint: Stop the program first.

tags.name: ERR_VM_EXEC_CONTROL
tags.message: {command} is not possible now ({mode})
tags.hint: Wait for the program to reach a state that allows it, or stop it first.

tags.name: ERR_VM_OVERRIDE_PTR_UNSUPPORTED
tags.message: {obj_id} is a folder: it cannot be written from the app

tags.name: ERR_VM_OVERRIDE_BAD_RECORD
tags.message: A write to {obj_id} is broken ({declared_len} bytes for elements of {item_size})

tags.name: ERR_VM_EXEC_SELF_BARRIER
tags.message: The program tried to stop itself from inside a block

tags.name: ERR_VM_EXEC_FAULT_LATCHED
tags.message: The program is stopped by a critical error of {device_id} ({root_tag}): acknowledge it to start again
tags.hint: Fix the device error, then acknowledge it and run again.

tags.name: ERR_VM_PERIODIC_OVERRUN
tags.message: {block_idx} missed {missed} runs of its {period_ms} period
tags.hint: Give the block a longer period, or make what it runs shorter.

tags.name: ERR_VM_RETAIN_UNNAMED
tags.message: {obj_id} must have a name to be kept across restarts
tags.hint: Give the variable a name.

tags.name: ERR_VM_RETAIN_TOO_BIG
tags.message: Keeping {obj_id} needs {need} bytes; at most {max} are kept
tags.hint: Keep fewer or smaller variables across restarts.

tags.name: ERR_VM_RETAIN_MISMATCH
tags.message: The kept value of {obj_id} does not match it ({type}, {size} bytes)

tags.name: ERR_VM_RETAIN_CORRUPT
tags.message: The kept values are damaged at byte {offset}

tags.name: ERR_VM_SUB_TRACK_FULL
tags.message: Too many values to watch (at most {max})
tags.hint: Watch fewer values at once.

tags.name: ERR_VM_BLK_OUTPUT_TAKEN
tags.message: {slot} of {blk_id} writes {obj_id}, which another block already writes
tags.hint: Let only one block write the variable.

tags.name: ERR_VM_LOAD_EMPTY
tags.message: The program is empty
tags.hint: Add blocks to the program.

tags.name: ERR_VM_LOAD_ABORTED
tags.message: The program upload was cancelled at {packet}: send it again from the start
tags.hint: Load the program again.

tags.name: ERR_VM_LOAD_INCOMPLETE
tags.message: The program is incomplete: {id} was never loaded

tags.name: ERR_VM_NO_MEM
tags.message: No memory for the program ({size} bytes)
tags.hint: Make the program smaller.

tags.name: ERR_VM_BAD_ARG
tags.message: A program request is not valid

tags.name: ERR_VM_RANGE
tags.description: a count or value outside its limits
tags.message: {val} is outside {min}..{max}

tags.name: ERR_VM_DEV_HELD
tags.description: a device block's value held to its limit
tags.message: {block_idx}: {value} is outside {min}..{max}, the nearest end is sent
tags.hint: Bring the value into the range shown; until then the device runs at the end of its range.
